text: Then he gave them his shirt. "Take this shirt of mine and cast it over the face of my father. He will see again. And bring me all your family."
His third shirt. The first carried a lie. The second carried the truth. This one would carry healing.
As the caravan left Egypt, far away, an old man said: "I can smell Yusuf... if you would not think me weak in mind."
When the bearer of good news arrived, he cast the shirt over his face... and he could see again.
"Did I not tell you that I know from Allah what you do not know?"
Then the whole family travelled to Egypt. Yusuf raised his parents up onto the throne... and they all bowed down before him.
The sun. The moon. And eleven stars.
"O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality."
And he said: "He was good to me when He took me out of prison."
Notice what he did not say. He did not say "when He took me out of the well." Even now, he would not shame his brothers.
